If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after 1d6 + 1 days if you have at least 1 hit point the whole time.

rules.summary: Regain 1d6 HP every 10 minutes (if above 0 HP) and regrow severed body parts over 1d6+1 days.
rules.description: While you have at least 1 HP, regain 1d6 HP every 10 minutes and regrow lost body parts after 1d6 + 1 days.

rules.summary: You have resistance to one damage type determined by the gem set in the ring (Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder).
rules.description: You have resistance to one damage type determined by the gem set in the ring: Acid (Pearl), Cold (Tourmaline), Fire (Garnet), Force (Sapphire), Lightning (Citrine), Necrotic (Jet), Poison (Amethyst), Psychic (Jade), Radiant (Topaz), or Thunder (Spinel).

rules.summary: Grants Resistance to one chosen damage type while worn.
rules.description: You have Resistance to one damage type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder) associated with the ring.

rules.summary: While wearing this ring, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement, and magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be paralyzed or restrained.
rules.description: While you wear this ring, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be paralyzed or restrained.

rules.summary: Ignore Difficult Terrain; immune to magical speed reduction and the Paralyzed and Restrained conditions caused by magic.
rules.description: Difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed. Magic cannot reduce your Speed, nor can magic inflict the Paralyzed or Restrained conditions on you.

rules.summary: This ring has 3 charges. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing it, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed instead.
rules.description: This ring has 3 charges (regains 1d3 daily at dawn). When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing it, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that saving throw instead.

rules.summary: Reaction: expend 1 charge to turn a failed Dexterity saving throw into a success (3 charges, recharges on Long Rest).
rules.description: Contains 3 charges. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, use your Reaction to expend 1 charge and succeed instead.

rules.summary: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.
rules.description: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

rules.summary: Falling speed automatically slows to 60 ft per round and you take no falling damage.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, when you fall, your descent slows to 60 feet per round and you take 0 damage from the fall.

rules.summary: You are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine if you are lying, or know your creature type. Can make the ring invisible.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it. If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul.

rules.summary: Immunity to telepathic intrusion, thought reading, and alignment/lie detection. Preserves soul upon death.
rules.description: Grants complete immunity to telepathic intrusions and thought-reading magic. You can turn the ring invisible at will. If you die, your soul can safely inhabit the ring.

rules.summary: Contains 6 charges for Dancing Lights (at will in darkness), Faerie Fire, Ball Lightning (5d4 per ball), and Shooting Stars (5d4 per bead in 15-ft cube).
rules.description: While wearing this ring in dim light or darkness, you can cast Dancing Lights and Light from it at will. Has 6 charges (regains 1d6 daily at dawn). You can expend charges to cast: Faerie Fire (1 charge), Ball Lightning (2 charges: creates up to 4 glowing balls dealing 5d4 lightning damage each on DC 15 Dex save), or Shooting Stars (1-3 charges: launches 1 to 3 sparks exploding in a 15-foot cube for 5d4 fire damage each on DC 15 Dex save).

rules.summary: 6 charges: at-will Light spells, Faerie Fire, Ball Lightning, and Shooting Stars bursts.
rules.description: Contains 6 charges. Cast Dancing Lights at will in darkness. Expend charges for Faerie Fire (1 charge), Ball Lightning (2 charges, 5d4 Lightning each), or Shooting Stars (1–3 charges, 5d4 Fire per star).

rules.summary: While wearing this ring, you can cast the Telekinesis spell at will, but you can target only objects that aren't being worn or carried.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can cast the Telekinesis spell at will, but you can target only objects that aren't being worn or carried.

rules.summary: Action: cast Telekinesis at will targeting unheld objects (up to 1,000 lbs).
rules.description: Cast Telekinesis at will as an Action, targeting objects up to 1,000 pounds that aren't worn or carried.

rules.summary: Has 3 charges: make a ranged spell attack (+7 bonus, 60 ft range) expending 1–3 charges. Deals 2d10 force damage per charge and pushes target 5 ft per charge (DC 15 Str save).
rules.description: This ring has 3 charges (regains 1d3 daily at dawn). While wearing the ring, you can use an action and expend 1 to 3 of its charges to make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object you can see within 60 feet of you. The ring makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you expend, the target takes 2d10 force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you (DC 15 Strength save to resist push). Can also break doors/locks.

rules.summary: 3 charges: make +7 ranged spell attack dealing 2d10 Force damage and pushing 5 ft per charge spent (up to 6d10 Force and 15 ft push).
rules.description: Action: expend 1–3 charges to make a +7 spell attack (60 ft). Deals 2d10 Force damage and pushes 5 ft per charge (DC 15 Strength save).

rules.summary: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the Wish spell from it. Once the last charge is spent, the ring becomes a nonmagical ring.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the Wish spell from it. The ring regains no charges. Once the third charge is expended, the ring loses its magic and becomes a nonmagical ring.

rules.summary: Action: expend 1 charge to cast Wish (3 charges total, non-rechargeable).
rules.description: Action: cast Wish. Has 3 charges. Becomes nonmagical once all 3 charges are expended.

rules.summary: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface (such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava) as if it were harmless solid ground.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface (such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava) as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).

rules.summary: Walk and run across all liquid surfaces as solid ground.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can move across liquids (water, acid, snow, lava) as if they were solid ground.

rules.summary: While wearing this ring, you have resistance to cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you have resistance to cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

rules.summary: Resistance to Cold damage; complete protection against Extreme Cold environments.
rules.description: Grants Resistance to Cold damage and immunity to cold weather hazards down to -50°F.

rules.summary: 3 charges (recharges 1d3 daily at dawn). Cast Animal Friendship (DC 13), Fear (beasts only, DC 13), or Speak with Animals.
rules.description: This ring has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13), Fear (save DC 13, targeting only beasts with Int 3 or lower), or Speak with Animals.

rules.summary: Cast Animal Friendship, Fear (beasts), or Speak with Animals (3 charges).
rules.description: Allows casting nature spells to communicate with and charm beasts.

rules.summary: Action: summon a friendly Djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air for up to 1 hour (recharges daily at dawn).
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to summon a djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. It remains for up to 1 hour, until you dismiss it as an action, or until it drops to 0 hit points. The djinni is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your verbal commands.

rules.summary: Action: summon allied Djinni for 1 hour. Friendly and follows verbal commands (1/Long Rest).
rules.description: Summons a noble Djinni elemental ally from the Elemental Plane of Air to fight, transport, or assist for up to 1 hour.

item_ring_of_elemental_command.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Air / Earth / Fire / Water)

v2014.editionName: Ring of Elemental Command (Air / Earth / Fire / Water)

rules.summary: Contains 5 charges. Grants advantage on attacks vs elementals of its type, resistance to matching element, and allows casting signature high-level elemental spells (Chain Lightning, Earthquake, Fire Storm, Wall of Ice, etc.).
rules.description: This ring is linked to one of the four Elemental Planes (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water). Has 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 daily at dawn). Grants resistance to the associated damage type, elemental speech, and powerful thematic spellcasting.

v2024.editionName: Ring of Elemental Command (Air / Earth / Fire / Water)

rules.summary: 5 charges: elemental immunity/resistance, domination over planar creatures, and devastating elemental magic.
rules.description: Legendary elemental focus ring granting elemental control and signature planar spells.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 17

rules.summary: While wearing this ring, you can cast the Jump spell from it as a bonus action at will, but can target only yourself.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can cast the Jump spell from it as a bonus action at will, but can target only yourself.

rules.summary: Bonus Action: cast Jump at will targeting self (triples jumping distances).
rules.description: Cast Jump on yourself as a Bonus Action at will without expending spell slots.

rules.summary: Advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only you (not an area). If you roll a 20 on the save and the spell is 7th level or lower, the spell is reflected back onto the caster.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only you (not an area). If you roll a 20 on the save and the spell is 7th level or lower, the spell has no effect on you and instead targets the caster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

rules.summary: Advantage on saves vs targeted spells; Natural 20 reflects spells up to 7th level back onto original caster.
rules.description: Legendary abjuration ring reflecting hostile targeted spells back at their casters.

rules.summary: You have a swimming speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.
rules.description: You have a swimming speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.

rules.summary: Grants Swim Speed of 40 feet.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you gain a Swim Speed of 40 feet.

rules.summary: Action: gain X-ray vision for 1 minute up to 30 feet (penetrates 1 ft stone, 1 inch metal, 3 ft wood/dirt; blocked by lead). Each use past the first per rest requires DC 15 Con save or 1 level of exhaustion.
rules.description: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to speak its command word. For 1 minute, you gain X-ray vision out to 30 feet. To you, solid matter appears transparent. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances block the vision, as does a thin sheet of lead.

rules.summary: Action: 30 ft X-ray vision through walls and doors for 1 minute. Con save against Exhaustion on repeated uses.
rules.description: Enables vision through physical barriers up to 30 feet away for 1 minute.

rules.summary: Action: press the button to fix the rod in place in mid-air. It defies gravity and holds up to 8,000 pounds of weight (DC 30 Strength check to move 10 ft).
rules.description: This flat iron rod has a button on one end. You can use an action to press the button, which causes the rod to become magically fixed in place. Wherever you push the button, the rod remains in place, even if defying gravity. The rod can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight. More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall. A creature can use an action to make a DC 30 Strength check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 feet on a success.

rules.summary: Action: lock in place anywhere in space. Holds up to 8,000 lbs (DC 30 Strength check to move).
rules.description: Press the button as an Action to fix the rod in its current position in mid-air. Supports up to 8,000 pounds before deactivating.

rules.summary: While holding this rod, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. Regain 1 warlock spell slot as an action once per day.
rules.description: While holding this rod, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a long rest.

rules.summary: +1 to Warlock Spell Attacks and Spell Save DC; Action: regain 1 Warlock spell slot once per Long Rest.
rules.description: Grants +1 bonus to Warlock spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC. Action: regain 1 expended Warlock spell slot (once per Long Rest).

rules.summary: While holding this rod, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. Regain 1 warlock spell slot once per day.
rules.description: While holding this rod, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod (once per long rest).

rules.summary: +2 to Warlock Spell Attacks and Spell Save DC; Action: regain 1 Warlock spell slot once per Long Rest.
rules.description: Grants +2 bonus to Warlock spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC. Action: regain 1 expended Warlock spell slot (once per Long Rest).

rules.summary: While holding this rod, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. Regain 1 warlock spell slot once per day.
rules.description: While holding this rod, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod (once per long rest).

rules.summary: +3 to Warlock Spell Attacks and Spell Save DC; Action: regain 1 Warlock spell slot once per Long Rest.
rules.description: Grants +3 bonus to Warlock spell attack rolls and Spell Save DC. Action: regain 1 expended Warlock spell slot (once per Long Rest).

rules.summary: Reaction: absorb spells targeted only at you, nullifying their effect and storing the spell levels (up to 50 levels max) to convert into free spell slots.
rules.description: While holding this rod, you can use your reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and not with an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy is stored in the rod (1 level per spell level). The rod can absorb a total of 50 levels in its lifetime. If you are a spellcaster, you can convert stored energy into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared without expending slots.

rules.summary: Reaction: absorb targeted spells up to 50 levels total in rod's lifetime and convert to free spell slots.
rules.description: Reaction to counter and absorb targeted spells. Stored energy powers your own spell slots without using your personal spell slots.

rules.summary: +1 mace granting advantage on Initiative and Wisdom checks. Can cast Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Poison and Disease, and See Invisibility. Action: plant rod to create 120-ft aura granting +1 AC and advantage on all saves.
rules.description: This rod has a flanged head and functions as a magic mace that grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. While holding it, you have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Wisdom (Perception) checks, and on initiative rolls. Spells: Cast Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Poison and Disease, or See Invisibility. Protective Aura: Plant rod into the ground as an action: creates a 60-foot aura granting allies +1 AC and saves, and bright light.

rules.summary: +1 Mace; Advantage on Initiative, Perception, Insight; Divination spells; Action: plant rod for 60 ft +1 AC and Save aura.
rules.description: +1 weapon and divination focus. Advantage on Initiative and Perception. Plant in ground for 10-minute protective aura.
rules.masteryProperties: Sap

rules.summary: +2 mace with 6 mechanical transformation buttons (transforms into +3 Flame Tongue Flail, +3 Spear, +3 Battleaxe, 50-ft Climbing Pole, or Battering Ram) and 3 spell powers (Drain 4d6 HP, DC 17 Paralysis, DC 17 Frighten).
rules.description: This rod has a flanged head and 6 buttons along its shaft. Functions as a +2 magic mace. Button 1: +3 Flame Tongue sword/flail. Button 2: +3 Spear. Button 3: +3 Battleaxe. Button 4: 50-ft climbing pole. Button 5: Door-battering ram (+10 to Strength checks). Button 6: Deconstructs into normal rod. Spell properties: Life Drain (4d6 necrotic), Paralyze (DC 17 Str save for 1 min), Terrify (DC 17 Wis save).

rules.summary: Multifunctional +2/+3 weapon; transforms into flail, spear, battleaxe, ladder, or ram. Life drain, paralysis, and fear effects.
rules.description: 6 distinct transformation modes and powerful combat effects in a single legendary rod.
rules.masteryProperties: Vex / Topple / Cleave / Sap

rules.summary: Action: speak command word to charm all creatures within 120 feet for 8 hours (DC 15 Wisdom save). Charmed creatures regard you as their trusted leader.
rules.description: You can use an action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 8 hours. While charmed in this way, the creature regards you as its trusted leader. If harmed by you or your companions, or commanded to do something contrary to its nature, the charm ends. Recharges daily at dawn.

rules.summary: Action: Charm all chosen creatures in 120 ft for 8 hours on failed DC 15 Wisdom save (1/Long Rest).
rules.description: Action: command obedience in 120 ft radius. Charmed creatures treat you as trusted leader for up to 8 hours.

rules.summary: Action: transport yourself and up to 199 other willing creatures to a tranquil extradimensional paradise demiplane for up to 200 days (10 days recharge per day spent in paradise).
rules.description: While holding this rod, you can use an action to activate it. The rod teleports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a tranquil pocket dimension paradise. Visitors do not age, natural healing occurs at twice normal rate, and lavish feasts and pristine lodging are provided. When the effect ends, all visitors return to their original locations. Can't be used again until 10 days pass for each day spent in the paradise.

rules.summary: Action: transport up to 200 creatures to a tranquil, restorative demiplane paradise.
rules.description: Teleports up to 200 willing creatures to a safe pocket dimension with food, clean lodging, and accelerated healing for up to 200 days.

item_rod_of_resurrection.name: Rod of Resurrection
item_rod_of_resurrection.attunementRequirement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin

rules.summary: Contains 5 charges. Cast Heal (6th level) for 1 charge or Resurrection (7th level) for 5 charges. 5% chance of rod crumbling to dust when 0 charges remain.
rules.description: This rod has 5 charges (regains 1 daily at dawn). While holding it, you can use an action to cast Heal (1 charge) or Resurrection (5 charges). If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the rod turns to dust and is destroyed.

rules.summary: 5 charges: cast Heal (1 charge) or Resurrection (5 charges). Essential divine restoration staff.
rules.description: Divine artifact with 5 charges to cast Heal (6th level) or bring the deceased back with Resurrection (5 charges).

item_spell_scroll_cantrip.name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
item_spell_scroll_cantrip.diffSummary: 2024 rules allow cross-class scroll casting with an Arcana check.
diffHighlights: 2024: Cross-class scroll casting enabled via Arcana check.

rules.summary: A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell written in a mystical cipher. Reading the scroll casts the cantrip without components, and the scroll crumbles to dust.
rules.description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your class’s spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the scroll crumbles to dust.

rules.summary: Cast inscribed Cantrip. In 2024, anyone with Spellcasting or Pact Magic can use spell scrolls from any class list by succeeding on an Arcana check.
rules.description: Read the scroll to cast the inscribed Cantrip. Under 2024 rules, characters can attempt to cast scrolls from other class lists via DC 10 + spell level Arcana checks.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 13

rules.summary: Cast 1st-level spell without material components. Consumed on use.
rules.description: A spell scroll bears the words of a 1st-level spell. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast it without components (Save DC 13, +5 Attack). The scroll crumbles to dust once cast.

rules.summary: Cast 1st-level spell. Cross-class scroll use with Arcana check.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 1st-level spell. Save DC equals caster DC or DC 13.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 13

rules.summary: Cast 2nd-level spell without material components (Save DC 13, +5 Attack). Consumed on use.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing a 2nd-level spell. If the spell is of a higher level than you can normally cast, make an ability check with your spellcasting ability (DC 12) to cast successfully.

rules.summary: Cast 2nd-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 13.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 2nd-level spell. DC 12 check if higher level than you normally cast.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 13

rules.summary: Cast 3rd-level spell without material components (Save DC 15, +7 Attack). Consumed on use.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing a 3rd-level spell (such as Fireball, Counterspell, or Revivify). Ability check DC 13 if above your spell slot level.

rules.summary: Cast 3rd-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 15.
rules.description: Cast inscribed 3rd-level spell. Save DC equals caster DC or DC 15.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 15

rules.summary: Cast 4th-level spell without material components (Save DC 15, +7 Attack). Ability check DC 14 if above your spell slot level.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing a 4th-level spell (such as Dimension Door, Polymorph, or Greater Invisibility).

rules.summary: Cast 4th-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 15.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 4th-level spell.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 15

rules.summary: Cast 5th-level spell without material components (Save DC 17, +9 Attack). Ability check DC 15 if above your spell slot level.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing a 5th-level spell (such as Cone of Cold, Wall of Force, or Greater Restoration).

rules.summary: Cast 5th-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 17.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 5th-level spell.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 17

rules.summary: Cast 6th-level spell without material components (Save DC 17, +9 Attack). Ability check DC 16 if above your spell slot level.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing a 6th-level spell (such as Disintegrate, Heal, Sunbeam, or True Seeing). If the spell is above your level, make a DC 16 spellcasting ability check.

rules.summary: Cast 6th-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 17.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 6th-level spell. DC 16 check if beyond your spell level.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 17

rules.summary: Cast 7th-level spell without material components (Save DC 18, +10 Attack). Ability check DC 17 if above your spell slot level.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing a 7th-level spell (such as Plane Shift, Forcecage, Teleport, or Finger of Death). Ability check DC 17 if above your spell slot level.

rules.summary: Cast 7th-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 18.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 7th-level spell. DC 17 check if beyond your spell level.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 18

rules.summary: Cast 8th-level spell without material components (Save DC 18, +10 Attack). Ability check DC 18 if above your spell slot level.
rules.description: A spell scroll bearing an 8th-level spell (such as Sunburst, Dominate Monster, Mind Blank, or Demiplane). Ability check DC 18 if above your spell slot level.

rules.summary: Cast 8th-level spell. Save DC uses your DC or DC 18.
rules.description: Read scroll to cast 8th-level spell. DC 18 check if beyond your spell level.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 18

rules.summary: Cast world-altering 9th-level spell without material components (Save DC 19, +11 Attack). Ability check DC 19 if below 9th level casting.
rules.description: A legendary parchment bearing a 9th-level spell (Wish, Meteor Swarm, True Polymorph, Power Word Kill). If the spell is above your level, make a DC 19 spellcasting ability check. On a failure, the scroll is lost with no effect.

rules.summary: Cast 9th-level spell. Consumed upon casting.
rules.description: Cast 9th-level spell. DC 19 check if beyond current spell tier. Consumed when read.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 19

rules.summary: Action: creates a 5-foot-radius barrier protecting against Aberrations, Beasts, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Plants, or Undead for 5 minutes.
rules.description: Using an action to read the scroll creates a 5-foot-radius barrier of magical energy extending from you. For 5 minutes, creatures of the specified type (Aberrations, Beasts, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Plants, or Undead) can't enter or willingly reach into the barrier, and targets within the barrier cannot be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them. Barrier moves with you.

rules.summary: Action: 5-ft mobile ward barring chosen creature type and granting immunity to Charmed/Frightened/Possessed for 5 minutes.
rules.description: Read as an Action to create a 5-foot protective aura centered on you that prevents designated creature types from entering or attacking inside for 5 minutes.

item_staff_of_power.name: Staff of Power
item_staff_of_power.attunementRequirement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
item_staff_of_power.diffSummary: In 2024, spells cast from the staff use your own Spell Save DC if higher than DC 17.
diffHighlights: 2024: Magic focus save DCs scale using your own Spell Save DC if higher than the staff's default DC 17.

rules.summary: +2 staff granting +2 to AC, saving throws, and spell attack rolls with 20 charges for high-tier spells and Retributive Strike.
rules.description: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. The staff has 20 charges (regains 2d8 + 4 charges daily at dawn). You can expend charges to cast: cone of cold (5 charges), fireball (5th-level, 5 charges), globe of invulnerability (6 charges), hold monster (5 charges), levitate (2 charges), lightning bolt (5th-level, 5 charges), magic missile (1 charge), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or wall of force (5 charges). You can use an action to break the staff over your knee for a Retributive Strike (deals up to 400 force damage based on charges).

rules.summary: +2 staff with +2 to AC, Saves, and Spell Attacks; 20 charges that now scale with your own Spell Save DC.
rules.description: Quarterstaff (+2 bonus to attack and damage rolls). While holding it, gain a +2 bonus to AC, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. Has 20 charges. Spells cast through the staff now use YOUR spell save DC and spell attack bonus (or DC 17, whichever is higher). Includes Retributive Strike.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 17 (whichever is higher)

item_staff_of_the_magi.name: Staff of the Magi
item_staff_of_the_magi.attunementRequirement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
item_staff_of_the_magi.diffSummary: Staff spell DC scales with caster's own Spell Save DC in 2024.
diffHighlights: 2024: Scaled save DC and updated Plane Shift / Telekinesis rules.

rules.summary: +2 quarterstaff, +2 to spell attack rolls, spell absorption, and 50 charges for casting world-shaking spells and devastating Retributive Strike.
rules.description: This staff grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls and +2 to spell attack rolls. Spell Absorption: Reaction to absorb a targeted spell and convert into charges. 50 charges (regains 4d6 + 2 daily at dawn). Cast at-will spells (Arcane Lock, Detect Magic, Enlarge/Reduce, Light, Mage Hand, Protection from Evil and Good) or expending charges for Conjure Elemental, Dispel Magic, Fireball (7th-level), Flaming Sphere, Ice Storm, Invisibility, Knock, Lightning Bolt (7th-level), Passwall, Plane Shift, Telekinesis, Wall of Fire (7th-level), or Web. Retributive Strike: Deals up to 800 damage.

rules.summary: +2 staff and +2 to Spell Attacks; Spell Absorption reaction; 50 charges scaling with your own DC.
rules.description: Iconic legendary staff. Spell Absorption reaction absorbs incoming magic to restore charges. Spells cast through the staff utilize your own Spell Save DC or DC 17.
rules.savingThrowDc: Your Spell Save DC or DC 17

item_staff_of_fire.name: Staff of Fire
item_staff_of_fire.attunementRequirement: by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

rules.description: While you wear this cloak, it projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property is suppressed until the start of your next turn.

rules.summary: Imposes Disadvantage on all incoming attack rolls. Suppressed until next turn when you take damage.
rules.description: Projects an illusory optical shift, conferring constant defensive evasion.

rules.summary: While wearing this cloak with the hood up, you can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed of 60 feet. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action.
rules.description: While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can breathe underwater, and you have a swimming speed of 60 feet.

rules.summary: Underwater breathing and 60 ft Swim Speed while hood is active.
rules.description: Aquatic cloak enabling rapid swimming and amphibious survival.

rules.summary: Has 36 charges (regains 1d20 daily at dawn). Press one of 6 faces as an action to create a 15-foot cubic barrier blocking gas, nonliving matter, living matter, spells, or all things.
rules.description: This cube has 36 charges. Pressing faces creates custom protective force barriers around you that move with you.

rules.summary: 36 charges: customizable 15-ft impenetrable barrier blocking matter, spells, and environmental hazards.
rules.description: Tactical force field generator adapting to block various types of incoming harm.

rules.summary: Action: uncork to emit thick smoke in a 60-foot radius, expanding 10 feet per minute up to 120 feet. Heavily obscures vision. Action to recork.
rules.description: Smoke constantly trickles from the lead stopper of this brass bottle. Uncorking releases a massive cloud of thick smoke.

rules.summary: Action: uncork for massive 60–120 ft radius obscuring smoke field.
rules.description: Creates vast tactical smoke concealment blocking line of sight.

rules.summary: While wearing these crystal lenses, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Can discern fine details up to 1 mile away.
rules.description: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes and magnify distant objects.

rules.summary: Advantage on sight-based Perception; eagle telescopic sight up to 1 mile.
rules.description: Precision scout optics granting telescopic sight and Advantage on visual search.

rules.summary: Action: speak command word 1 to unfold into a 10-foot rowboat (4 passengers), command word 2 for a 24-foot sailing ship with cabin (15 passengers), or command word 3 to fold back into a 12-inch wooden box.
rules.description: This wooden box is 12 inches long, 6 inches wide, and 6 inches deep. Commands unfold it into ocean-ready vessels.

rules.summary: Action: expands into 10-ft rowboat or 24-ft sailing vessel; folds into portable box.
rules.description: Modular nautical vessel box providing instant maritime transportation.

rules.summary: Contains 50 charges. Shed light (0 charges), shoot beam blinding 1 creature on DC 15 Con save (1 charge), or unleash 60-foot cone blinding all creatures for 1 minute (5 charges). Non-rechargeable.
rules.description: This prism has 50 charges and emits dazzling bursts of solar brilliance.

rules.summary: 50 charges: at-will illumination, single-target blindness ray, and 60-ft cone blinding flash.
rules.description: Crystal prism generating intense radiant bursts to blind foes.

rules.summary: Has 3 charges (regains 1d3 daily at dawn). Action: peer through the gem for 10 minutes to gain Truesight out to 120 feet.
rules.description: This gem has 3 charges. Peering through it grants Truesight to see through magical darkness, invisible creatures, illusions, visual shapechangers, and into the Ethereal Plane.

rules.summary: 3 charges: peer through lens for 10 minutes of 120 ft Truesight.
rules.description: Divination prism revealing all invisible, ethereal, and shapeshifted entities.

rules.summary: When a ranged weapon attack hits you, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier. If damage is reduced to 0, you catch the missile if you have a free hand.
rules.description: These gloves seem to move on their own to snatch projectiles out of the air.

rules.summary: Reaction: deflect ranged weapon attacks, reducing damage by 1d10 + Dex and catching missile if damage reaches 0.
rules.description: Enchanted defensive gloves snatching arrows and thrown weapons out of flight.

rules.summary: These gloves are invisible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks made to pick locks with thieves' tools.
rules.description: Supple, translucent rogue's gloves boosting precision manual dexterity.

rules.summary: +5 bonus on Sleight of Hand and Thieves' Tools checks; invisible while equipped.
rules.description: Masterwork lockpicking and pickpocketing gloves adding a flat +5 bonus.

rules.summary: Contains 3 charges (regains 1d3 daily at dawn). While wearing it, use an action to expend 1 charge to cast the Teleport spell.
rules.description: This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge to cast Teleport.

rules.summary: 3 charges: cast Teleport (7th level) anywhere across the current plane.
rules.description: Legendary long-distance traversal helm.

rules.summary: While lit, sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's bright light.
rules.description: While lit, this hooded lantern reveals invisible creatures and hidden ethereal objects in its bright light beam.

rules.summary: Reveals all invisible creatures and objects within 30 ft bright light radius.
rules.description: Essential dungeon exploration lantern unmasking invisible stalkers and hidden objects.

rules.summary: Action: command this 60-foot rope to snake forward up to 50 feet and securely knot/fasten itself to an anchor point. Bonus action: create knot handholds (advantage on Athletics to climb). Supports up to 3,000 lbs.
rules.description: This 60-foot silk rope moves under telepathic/verbal command to scale cliffs and secure rappels.

rules.summary: Action: snake up to 50 ft to tie off to anchors. Creates knot handholds for effortless climbing.
rules.description: Enchanted climbing rope securing ascents and descents across sheer surfaces.

rules.summary: Action: command rope to lash out at a creature within 20 feet. Target must pass DC 15 Dex save or become restrained. DC 15 Strength or DC 20 Dexterity check to break free.
rules.description: This 30-foot rope springs forward to wrap around and bind a target with supernatural strength.

rules.summary: Action: bind target in 20 ft with Restrained condition on failed DC 15 Dex save.
rules.description: Tactical crowd-control rope restraining foes without requiring spell slots.

rules.summary: Action: speak command word to transform cloak into bat or bird wings, gaining a flying speed of 60 feet for 1 hour. Can't be used again for 1d12 hours.
rules.description: While wearing this cloak, you can use an action to speak its command word. This turns the cloak into a pair of bat wings or bird wings on your back for 1 hour or until you repeat the command word as an action. While the wings are present, you have a flying speed of 60 feet.

rules.summary: Action: deploy wings granting 60 ft Flying Speed for 1 hour (recharges in 1d12 hours).
rules.description: Transforms cloak into wings enabling rapid 60-foot flight speed.

rules.description: This heavy leather-bound tome contains health, diet, and physical endurance regimens. Once read, its words vanish and its magic is spent for a century.

rules.summary: Study for 48 hours to gain permanent +2 to Constitution and Constitution maximum.
rules.description: Permanent physical enhancement tome increasing Constitution and raising ability score cap.

rules.summary: Study for 48 hours to gain permanent +2 to Strength and Strength maximum.
rules.description: Permanent martial training manual increasing Strength and raising ability score cap.

rules.summary: Spend 48 hours over 6 days studying this book to permanently increase your Dexterity score by 2 and your maximum for that score by 2. The manual loses its magic for 100 years.
rules.description: Contains agility exercises and balance mastery diagrams. Once read, the text fades and the manual becomes nonmagical for 100 years.

rules.summary: Study for 48 hours to gain permanent +2 to Dexterity and Dexterity maximum.
rules.description: Permanent acrobatics and reflex manual increasing Dexterity and raising ability score cap.

rules.summary: Contains formulas to animate a Clay Golem. Requires 30 days of continuous work and 65,000 gp in materials. The manual burns to ash upon completion.
rules.description: A comprehensive arcane treatise containing the precise alchemical and mystical incantations needed to animate a loyal Clay Golem.

rules.summary: Crafting manual for constructing an animated Clay Golem.
rules.description: Downtime construction guide enabling high-level spellcasters to build an obedient Clay Golem.

rules.summary: Contains instructions to assemble and animate a Flesh Golem. Requires 60 days of continuous work and 50,000 gp in materials. The manual burns to ash upon completion.
rules.description: Treatise bound in stitched hide detailing the binding of elemental spirits into crafted flesh.

rules.summary: Crafting manual for assembling and animating a Flesh Golem.
rules.description: Downtime construction guide enabling spellcasters to create an obedient Flesh Golem.

rules.summary: Contains instructions to forge and animate an Iron Golem. Requires 120 days of continuous work and 100,000 gp in materials. The manual burns to ash upon completion.
rules.description: Heavy metal-bound folio detailing the masterwork metallurgy and binding rites of an Iron Golem.

rules.summary: Crafting manual for forging and animating an Iron Golem.
rules.description: Downtime construction guide for forging a towering, impervious Iron Golem.

rules.summary: Contains instructions to sculpt and animate a Stone Golem. Requires 90 days of continuous work and 80,000 gp in materials. The manual burns to ash upon completion.
rules.description: Chiseled stone tablets bound together detailing the animation of a monolithic Stone Golem.

rules.summary: Crafting manual for sculpting and animating a Stone Golem.
rules.description: Downtime construction guide for shaping and animating a Stone Golem.

rules.summary: Spend 48 hours over 6 days studying this book to permanently increase your Intelligence score by 2 and your maximum for that score by 2. The tome loses its magic for 100 years.
rules.description: This arcane folio contains logic proofs, mnemonics, and cognitive exercises. Once read, its pages turn blank for a century.

rules.summary: Study for 48 hours to gain permanent +2 to Intelligence and Intelligence maximum.
rules.description: Permanent cognitive enhancement tome increasing Intelligence and raising ability score cap.

rules.summary: Spend 48 hours over 6 days studying this book to permanently increase your Charisma score by 2 and your maximum for that score by 2. The tome loses its magic for 100 years.
rules.description: Contains principles of leadership, rhetoric, and magnetism. Once read, its words vanish for 100 years.

rules.summary: Study for 48 hours to gain permanent +2 to Charisma and Charisma maximum.
rules.description: Permanent personality and rhetoric enhancement tome increasing Charisma and raising ability score cap.

rules.summary: Spend 48 hours over 6 days studying this book to permanently increase your Wisdom score by 2 and your maximum for that score by 2. The tome loses its magic for 100 years.
rules.description: Contains philosophical and spiritual insights on intuition and awareness. Once read, its pages turn blank for 100 years.

rules.summary: Study for 48 hours to gain permanent +2 to Wisdom and Wisdom maximum.
rules.description: Permanent spiritual and intuitive enhancement tome increasing Wisdom and raising ability score cap.

rules.summary: Grants climbing speed equal to walking speed, Spider Climb (can move upside down on ceilings), poison damage resistance, immunity to webs, and cast Web (DC 13, twice standard area) once per day.
rules.description: A black silk cloak with subtle web embroidery. Gives the wearer complete freedom of movement within webs and spider mobility.

rules.summary: Climb speed, Spider Climb trait, Poison resistance, Web immunity, and 1/Day expanded Web spell.
rules.description: Arachnid garment granting wall-crawling, poison warding, and massive web creation.

rules.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.
rules.description: A shimmering woven mantle that deflects offensive magical energies.

rules.summary: Passive: Advantage on saving throws against all spells and spell effects.
rules.description: Abjuration cloak providing continuous spell warding.

rules.summary: Robe covered in eye motifs. Grants 360-degree vision, advantage on Perception checks relying on sight, 120 ft darkvision, and ability to see invisible/ethereal creatures within 120 ft. Vulnerable to Light/Daylight blinding.
rules.description: This robe is adorned with stylized eye patterns that blink and track movement in all directions.

rules.summary: 360° vision, 120 ft darkvision, ethereal vision, sight advantage; vulnerable to sudden bright light flashes.
rules.description: Divination robe granting panoramic all-seeing vision.

rules.summary: Has 3 charges (regains 1d3 daily at dawn). Action: shed hypnotic shifting colors for 30 ft. Attack rolls against you have disadvantage, and creatures in 30 ft must succeed on a DC 15 Wis save or become stunned until the start of their next turn.
rules.description: A robe woven from kaleidoscopic silk that dazzles and stuns onlookers with shifting prismatic waves.

rules.summary: 3 charges: dazzling kaleidoscopic light imposing disadvantage on incoming attacks and stunning nearby foes (DC 15 Wis).
rules.description: Illusion and enchantment robe distorting enemy perception.

rules.summary: +1 bonus to all saving throws. As an action, enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and return as an action. Has 6 silver stars; as an action, pluck a star to cast 5th-level Magic Missile (regains 1d6 stars daily at dusk).
rules.description: A midnight blue robe stitched with six glowing silver stars and constellations.

rules.summary: +1 to all saving throws, at-will Astral Plane transition, and 6 stars to cast 5th-level Magic Missile.
rules.description: Planar traveling robe with offensive celestial darts and abjuration protection.

rules.summary: While wearing this cap underwater, you can speak its command word as an action to create a bubble of air around your head. It allows you to breathe normally underwater until you speak the command word again.
rules.description: A cap made of woven kelp that encloses the wearer's head in a breathable pocket of air.

rules.summary: Action: create renewable air bubble around head allowing underwater breathing.
rules.description: Aquatic utility cap providing infinite underwater respiration.

rules.summary: Has 3 charges (regains all at dawn). Action: cast Charm Person (save DC 13) on a humanoid within 30 feet that can see you.
rules.description: Crystal lenses that fit over the eyes, imparting an alluring luminescence to your gaze.

rules.summary: 3 charges: cast Charm Person (DC 13 Wis save) on a target looking at you.
rules.description: Enchantment lenses subverting target hostility with charismatic gaze.

rules.summary: These crystal lenses allow you to see much better at close range. You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks that rely on sight while searching an area or examining something within 1 foot of you.
rules.description: Magnifying crystal spectacles revealing microscopic fractures, hidden runes, and intricate lock mechanisms.

rules.summary: Passive: Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks for inspecting objects within 1 foot.
rules.description: Microscopic inspection lenses for trap disarming and forensic analysis.

rules.summary: Set with diamonds, rubies, fire opals, and opals. Grants fire resistance, 30 ft radiant illumination dealing 1d6 radiant to undead at start of turn, weapon fire damage (+1d6), and action to cast Daylight (opal), Fireball (ruby, DC 18), Prismatic Spray (diamond, DC 18), or Wall of Fire (fire opal, DC 18). Detonates if wearer fails saving throw against fire.
rules.description: A dazzling crown of polished silver studded with brilliant gemstones that channel solar and elemental fire.

rules.summary: Gem matrix casting Daylight, Fireball (DC 18), Wall of Fire (DC 18), and Prismatic Spray (DC 18) with passive fire resistance.
rules.description: High-power combat helm radiating blinding light and explosive elemental spells.

rules.description: An open-faced steel helm inscribed with ancient translation runes.

rules.summary: Action: at-will Comprehend Languages casting.
rules.description: Translation headpiece deciphering any spoken language or written script.

rules.summary: While wearing this helm, you can use an action to cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) at will. While maintaining concentration on the spell, you can use an action to send a telepathic message or cast Suggestion (save DC 13) on the target once per day.
rules.description: A polished metallic helm that amplifies the wearer's psionic and telepathic faculties.

rules.summary: Action: at-will Detect Thoughts (DC 13) and 1/Day Suggestion (DC 13).
rules.description: Mental espionage headpiece reading thoughts and projecting telepathic commands.

rules.summary: Has 3 charges (regains 1d3 daily at dawn). While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 13) from it.
rules.description: A silver disc inscribed with labyrinthine mind sigils on a delicate chain.

rules.summary: 3 charges: cast Detect Thoughts (DC 13) from pendant.
rules.description: Telepathic amulet for scanning nearby minds and surface thoughts.

rules.description: A leaden amulet shielding the wearer completely from clairvoyance, scrying sensors, and locator spells.

v2024.editionName: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location

rules.summary: Passive: Total immunity to divination targeting and magical scrying sensors.
rules.description: Anti-surveillance pendant protecting the wearer from all forms of magical observation.

rules.description: A heavy platinum talisman containing miniature planar dials and celestial gears.

rules.summary: Action: cast Plane Shift with DC 15 Int check; failure triggers wild interplanar teleportation.
rules.description: Interplanar transit relic opening portals across the multiverse.

rules.description: A string of sacred semi-precious beads that channel divine magic swiftly as bonus actions.

rules.summary: Bonus Action divine spellcasting from beads (Bless, Cure Wounds, Restorations, Planar Ally).
rules.description: Sacred prayer beads providing bonus-action divine spell versatility.

rules.summary: You are immune to contracting any disease while you wear this pendant. If you are already infected with disease, its effects are suppressed while wearing the periapt.
rules.description: A blue gem set into a silver brooch that purifies the wearer's bloodstream of all biological pathogens.

rules.summary: Passive: Complete immunity to disease and suppression of active infections.
rules.description: Sanitary medical talisman granting total disease immunity.

rules.summary: This delicate pendant makes you immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Any active poison is suppressed while worn.
rules.description: An emerald encased in platinum that neutralizing venoms, toxins, and environmental poisons.

rules.summary: Passive: Total immunity to poison damage and the Poisoned condition.
rules.description: Anti-venom talisman conferring permanent poison immunity.

rules.summary: Requires attunement by good spellcaster. +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and save DC. Has 7 charges. Action: choose an evil creature in 120 ft; target must pass DC 20 Dex save or earth opens to destroy them in a flaming fissure (8d6 radiant + 8d6 fire if saved). Talisman vanishes when last charge is used.
rules.description: A radiant golden talisman etched with symbols of celestial purity.

rules.summary: +2 to spell attacks and save DC; 7 charges to open earth beneath evil foes (DC 20 Dex save or obliterated).
rules.description: Legendary holy relic destroying evil entities with celestial judgment.

rules.summary: While holding this talisman, you double your proficiency bonus on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to control a Sphere of Annihilation and have advantage on the check.
rules.description: A black adamantine loop that stabilizes the gravitational pull of a Sphere of Annihilation.

rules.summary: Passive: Advantage and doubled proficiency on Arcana checks to manipulate a Sphere of Annihilation.
rules.description: Planar control focus ensuring mastery over black holes and spheres of annihilation.

rules.summary: Requires attunement by evil spellcaster. +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and save DC. Has 7 charges. Action: choose a good creature in 120 ft; target must pass DC 20 Dex save or earth opens to consume them in an abyssal fissure (8d6 necrotic + 8d6 fire if saved). Talisman crumbles when last charge is spent.
rules.description: A jagged piece of unholy black obsidian pulsating with malevolent crimson veins.

rules.summary: +2 to spell attacks and save DC; 7 charges to open abyssal chasm beneath good foes (DC 20 Dex save or obliterated).
rules.description: Legendary unholy relic destroying celestial and righteous foes.

rules.summary: Constitution increases by 2 (up to max of 20). Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Can speak, read, and write Dwarvish. Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks with dwarves. Grow a thick beard daily.
rules.description: A heavy leather belt with a forged bronze dwarven buckle honoring dwarven ancestry and resilience.

rules.summary: Passive: Constitution +2, Poison resistance/advantage, 60 ft Darkvision, Dwarvish fluency, and dwarf diplomacy advantage.
rules.description: Ancestral belt granting dwarven fortitude and racial traits.

rules.summary: Your walking speed becomes 30 feet unless it was already higher, and speed is not reduced if encumbered or in heavy armor. You can jump three times the normal distance.
rules.description: Supple leather boots that put a supernatural spring in your stride and prevent encumbrance slow-down.

rules.summary: Passive: 30 ft minimum walking speed immune to armor encumbrance; triple jumping distance.
rules.description: Mobility boots maximizing jump distance and heavy armor mobility.

rules.summary: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.
rules.description: Reinforced steel bands that generate an invisible protective force field around unarmored combatants.

rules.summary: Passive: +2 AC bonus while unarmored and without a shield.
rules.description: Abjuration bracers granting armored defense to unarmored spellcasters and monks.

rules.summary: While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming do not cost you extra movement, and you have a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.
rules.description: Webbed leather gloves with micro-traction palms for scaling vertical rock and slicing through water.

rules.summary: Passive: free swimming/climbing movement and +5 to Strength (Athletics) for traverse.
rules.description: Exploration gloves optimizing swimming speed and cliff climbing.

rules.summary: Set of 4 iron horseshoes. A horse or similar creature wearing them floats 4 inches above the ground. It can move across uneven terrain, water, and even lava without harm, leaving no tracks.
rules.description: Silvery horseshoes imbued with elemental air allowing steeds to gallop over chasms, water, and mud without touching the ground.

rules.summary: Passive: mount hovers 4 inches above ground, crossing difficult terrain and liquids without harm or tracks.
rules.description: Enchanted equestrian shoes enabling floating gallop over all surfaces.

rules.summary: Set of 4 horseshoes. While all four are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they increase its walking speed by 30 feet.
rules.description: Forged from lightweight celestial steel, these horseshoes bestow blistering acceleration upon equine mounts.

rules.summary: Passive: +30 ft walking speed for horse or mount.
rules.description: Speed-enhancing equestrian shoes for mounts.

rules.description: A heavy cloth pouch containing oversized speckled beans that grow miraculous structures and hazards.

rules.summary: Action: plant and water bean to spawn random d100 wondrous landmark, monster, or blessing.
rules.description: Chaotic gardening pouch producing unpredictable magical phenomena.

rules.summary: Hazardous cursed container devouring items and pulling creatures inside on failed DC 15 Strength save.
rules.description: Predatory extra-dimensional mimic bag consuming matter and careless adventurers.

rules.summary: While touching this crystal sphere, you can use an action to cast the Scrying spell (save DC 17) with it at will.
rules.description: A flawless 6-inch quartz sphere that reveals distant people and locations.

rules.summary: Action: at-will Scrying casting (DC 17 Wis save).
rules.description: Divination orb for long-range surveillance and tracking.

rules.description: A carnelian cube inscribed with planar geometries enabling direct gateway transit across the multiverse.

rules.summary: 3 charges: Plane Shift or open 1-minute two-way portal to 6 keyed planar destinations.
rules.description: Legendary interplanar key activating portals to configured realms.

rules.summary: Deck of 34 parchment cards. Action: draw a card at random and throw it up to 30 feet; an illusory creature spawns with visual and audio presence (Dragon, Iron Golem, Giant, Lich, Goblins). Moving card ends illusion.
rules.description: A boxed deck of cards painted with mythical beasts that spring into realistic phantasms when tossed.

rules.summary: Action: draw and toss card up to 30 ft to manifest realistic illusory monster.
rules.description: Illusion card deck deploying decoy creatures in tactical combat.

rules.summary: Action: fasten shackles onto an incapacitated creature. Automatically adjusts from Small to Large. Bound creature cannot teleport, use extradimensional travel (Ethereal Plane, Astral Plane, Blink, Misty Step, Plane Shift), or shapeshift. DC 30 Strength check to break free (1 attempt every 30 days).
rules.description: Golden adamantine manacles traced with antimagic locking runes.

rules.summary: Action: bind incapacitated target, blocking all teleportation, planar travel, and shapechanging (DC 30 Str break check).
rules.description: High-security planar prisoner restraints disabling teleportation and astral escape.

rules.summary: Action: throw sphere up to 60 ft with +6 ranged attack. On hit, iron bands expand to bind and restrain target (up to Huge size). Target can make DC 20 Strength check to burst free. Usable once per dawn.
rules.description: A 3-inch rusty iron sphere that instantly expands into a cage of interlocked metal bands on impact.

rules.summary: Action: +6 ranged attack within 60 ft to bind and restrain target up to Huge size on hit (DC 20 Str break).
rules.description: Deployable metallic restraint sphere locking down heavy targets.

rules.summary: Action: unstopper flask and target a creature within 60 ft from another plane. Target must pass DC 17 Wis save or be pulled inside. Action to release: creature obeys your commands for 1 hour, then acts on its own.
rules.description: A heavy iron bottle sealed with brass runes and lead stoppers designed to imprison outsiders, fiends, and celestials.

rules.summary: Action: imprison extraplanar entity (DC 17 Wis) or release to obey commands for 1 hour.
rules.description: Legendary entity containment vessel holding powerful fiends, elementals, and celestials.

rules.summary: Has 12 extra-dimensional cells. Any creature within 30 ft that sees its reflection must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma save or be trapped inside. The mirror can be covered or spoken to to release prisoners.
rules.description: A 4-foot tall framed mirror whose silvered glass reflects a doorway into twelve suspended animation chambers.

rules.summary: Reflection hazard trapping viewers in 12 dimensional cells on failed DC 15 Cha save; command word release.
rules.description: Dimensional containment mirror trapping intruders in extradimensional stasis.

rules.summary: Looks like a 6-foot circular black cloth. Action: unfold onto a flat surface to create a two-way portal to another world or plane (determined randomly by DM). Action: pull edges to fold and close the portal.
rules.description: A circular cloth woven from starlight that opens an open portal into distant planetary worlds and outer planes.

rules.summary: Action: deploy black cloth to create 6-foot two-way doorway to random planar world.
rules.description: Portable world-hopping portal sheet enabling interplanar exploration.

rules.summary: Action: fill bowl with water to cast Conjure Elemental (Water Elemental). The bowl can't be used again until next dawn.
rules.description: A blue ceramic basin adorned with wave and aquatic engravings.

rules.summary: Action: summon Water Elemental using basin of water (1/Day).
rules.description: Elemental focus for summoning and controlling obedient Water Elementals.

rules.summary: Action: light a fire in the brazier to cast Conjure Elemental (Fire Elemental). Usable once per dawn.
rules.description: A brass tripod brazier with flame engravings.

rules.summary: Action: summon Fire Elemental using lit brazier (1/Day).
rules.description: Elemental focus for summoning and commanding Fire Elementals.

rules.summary: Action: burn incense in censer to cast Conjure Elemental (Air Elemental). Usable once per dawn.
rules.description: A perforated brass censer swinging on a silver chain.

rules.summary: Action: summon Air Elemental using burning incense (1/Day).
rules.description: Elemental focus for summoning and commanding Air Elementals.

rules.summary: Action: place stone on dirt or rock to cast Conjure Elemental (Earth Elemental). Usable once per dawn.
rules.description: A rough geode resonant with elemental earth energy.

rules.summary: Action: summon Earth Elemental by setting stone on ground (1/Day).
rules.description: Elemental focus for summoning and commanding Earth Elementals.

rules.description: A curved horn made of polished brass that unleashes a thunderous sonic shockwave.

rules.summary: Action: 30-ft cone dealing 5d6 thunder damage and deafened condition (DC 15 Con). 20% malfunction detonation risk.
